description: Ice-core chronologies and the Antarctic cores they date, for the dating of the layers (fields "ice core" and "chronology" of raw_md.json): suggestions in the submission form, and a check that the chronology dates the core. Core names are those of the 3D viewer (web/src/icecores.ts), listed in "cores": a known core with a chronology that does not date it is refused. A chronology not listed here is accepted.

AICC2012.reference: Bazin et al. (2013); Veres et al. (2013), Climate of the Past

AICC2023.reference: Bouchet et al. (2023), Climate of the Past

EDC3.reference: Parrenin et al. (2007), Climate of the Past

EDML1.reference: Ruth et al. (2007), Climate of the Past

TALDICE-1.reference: Buiron et al. (2011), Climate of the Past

WD2014.reference: Buizert et al. (2015); Sigl et al. (2016), Climate of the Past

SP19.reference: Winski et al. (2019), Climate of the Past

DF2021.reference: Oyabu et al. (2022), Quaternary Science Reviews

ST22.reference: Mulvaney et al. (2023), Climate of the Past

RICE17.reference: Lee et al. (2020), Climate of the Past
